text:
You wander through those worlds as I do; do not tell me

you do not exist, you exist, we are to meet;

we shall not know each other, disguised and awkward

we shall set out along the roads.


We shall not know each other, distant one from another

you will feel my sighs and I will hear you sigh.

Where will the mouth be, the mouth that sighs?

We shall say, retracing the road.


Perhaps we will meet face to face someday,

perhaps we will manage to take off our disguises.

And now I ask myself... when it happens, if it happens,

will I know about sighs, will you know how to sigh?

translation.title: One Day...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the doubled uncertainty of recognition and sighing.
